title: Common Rail Pressure Sensor Low Error
detail_of_failure: A low voltage occurs in the signal circuit of the common rail pressure sensor.
controller_action: Operates the machine with the engine output limited.
machine_effect: • Engine speed or output lowers. • Engine does not start.
related_information: • The signal voltage of the common rail pressure sensor can be checked with monitoring function. (Code: 36401) • Even under the correct state, if the sensor connector is disconnected, this code is not shown but code [CA451] for High Error is shown. • After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Turn the starting switch to the ON position.

steps.procedure: Check the wiring harness and connector. For details, see “Related Information to Troubleshooting”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”.

steps.cause: Defective common rail pressure sensor power supply system
steps.procedure: If failure code [CA187] (ground fault of the sensor power supply line) or [CA227] is shown, do the troubleshooting for that code first.

Check that the failure code [CA187] (ground fault of the sensor power supply line) is not shown. 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector FUEL RAIL PRESS. 3. Starting switch: ON If the failure code changes from [CA452] to [CA451], the sensor is defective.

steps.cause: Ground fault in wiring harness (contact with ground circuit)
steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors ECM and FUEL RAIL PRESS, and connect T- adapter to female side of ECM.
1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors ECM and FUEL RAIL PRESS, and connect T- adapter to female side of ECM.

If no failure is found by the previous checks, the engine controller is defective. (Because this is an internal defect, troubleshooting cannot be done.) 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Insert a T-adapter into the connector ECM. 3. Starting switch: ON
